The '''Aparo sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was adjacent to the [[Wyl sector/Legends|Wyl sector]] and the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. Planets within Aparo sector included [[Cadomai Prime/Legends|Cadomai Prime]].

==History==
At the time of the [[Great Galactic War]], the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] made its opening moves against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Assault on the Aparo sector|conquered]] the worlds in the Aparo sector long before Republic reinforcements had even arrived.<ref name="OotSE" />

During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Catarlo was governed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Wyrrhem]].<ref name="HSatCSS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>
